articles.summary: Octolane's AI CRM team had more customer sessions than anyone could read. With Moda they found where users got confused, which workflows broke, and shipped five fixes in their first few weeks.
articles.title: How Octolane Turned 43,000 AI Chat Sessions into 5 Shipped Product Fixes

articles.summary: How to move an AI agent from Langfuse to Moda: repoint your OpenTelemetry exporter or swap the Langfuse SDK for the Moda SDK, carry your session and user IDs over, and import your Langfuse traces, sessions, users, and scores.
articles.title: Migrating from Langfuse

articles.title: Cohorts: see which AI users are about to churn, and why
